examples.title: Facts with icons
examples.description: Each fact is an icon and a value, separated from the next by space. The row wraps between facts, never inside one, and draws no separator glyph.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { KeyFacts } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import MapPin from '@lucide/svelte/icons/map-pin';
  import Martini from '@lucide/svelte/icons/martini';
  import DollarSign from '@lucide/svelte/icons/dollar-sign';
</script>

{#snippet venue()}<Martini size={14} />{/snippet}
{#snippet place()}<MapPin size={14} />{/snippet}
{#snippet price()}<DollarSign size={14} />{/snippet}

<KeyFacts
  label="Details"
  items={[
    { icon: venue, label: 'Kind', value: 'Cocktail bar' },
    { icon: place, label: 'Neighborhood', value: 'LoDo' },
    { icon: price, label: 'Price', value: '$$' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: A fact that links
examples.description: Pass href to make a value a link. The fact still wraps as a whole.
